questionEn: Which option correctly reveals the meaning of “biogenic elements”?
questionUz: Qaysi variant "biogen elementlar" ma'nosini to'g'ri ochib beradi?
choicesEn: Elements necessary for the life of organisms
choicesUz: Organizmlar hayoti uchun zarur bo'lgan elementlar
explanationEn: C, H, O, N, P, S, etc. - biogenic.
explanationUz: C, H, O, N, P, S va boshqalar - biogen.
